name: Huang Lu
bio: Huang Lu (simplified Chinese: 黄璐; traditional Chinese: 黃璐; pinyin: Huáng Lù) is a Chinese actress. A graduate of the Beijing Film Academy, Huang debuted in director Li Yang's Blind Mountain, where she played a young college student sold into sexual slavery in a mountain village in northern China.
